entry.title: New: RES26-207 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
AMENDING RESOLUTION 23-83, CD1, TO UPDATE THE PROJECT DESCRIPTION, INCORPORATE BY REFERENCE AN UPDATED LIST OF EXEMPTIONS FROM THE HAWAIʻI COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY'S MAUKA AREA RULES, AND EXTEND THE DEADLINE FOR THE COMMENCEMENT OF CONSTRUCTION FOR THE POHUKAINA COMMONS AFFORDABLE RENTAL AND MIXED-USE PROJECT IN KAKAʻAKO, OʻAHU.

Latest action: Introduced.
